propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate owned the alert-review workflow roadmap and prioritised the backlog each sprint with the compliance operations lead.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the roadmap ownership and prioritisation directly.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate ran the release review for six workflow releases and recorded decisions in the release record.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the release record document the reviews.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The share of alerts closed within the service-level target rose from 71 percent to 88 percent over four months after the alert-grouping release, against a documented baseline of 71 percent.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the figures, period, baseline and report; the work sample and reference confirm them.

expectedGap: Hand-over conditions for each release are only partly documented in the release notes.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the closure result as stated for the four months after the alert-grouping release; do not extend it to other workflow changes.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask how hand-over conditions were recorded for each release.
